    Built for the unread problem.Local-first · Evidence included · No chat upload

    Your chat belongs to you.

    CatchUp processes conversations in your browser. It has no chat server, analytics or cloud AI API. Chats are held in tab memory by default. If you turn on “Remember this chat,” the chat, settings and task completion states are saved in this browser’s local storage. Anyone using this browser profile could access that saved data. “Forget saved chat” removes it.

    Optional local AI: the browser downloads model files and runtime code from Hugging Face and jsDelivr. These requests expose normal connection information such as your IP address, but do not include your chat text. The model runs on your device and its files may be cached by your browser.

    AI summaries can make mistakes. Tasks and deadlines are detected using transparent rules; every finding links to its source message. Tentative date interpretations and unstated owners are marked. There is no automatic completion inference.

    Export: the brief is saved to your device only when you select Export. Uploaded .txt files are read locally.
